Clash of Legends

110 original fighters across 11 worlds, thirteen stages, 2v2 duo combos, player levels and mastery, costume-changing forms, unlockable skins, best-of-3 rounds. Juggles, wall bounces, breakers, perfect guard, form ladders that change your moves, sure-hit domains and twelve kinds of ULT.

How to play Every fighter's kit: 3 skills, 1 signature, 1 ULT, and forms. SKILL alone fires skill 1, hold toward the opponent + SKILL for skill 2, hold away + SKILL for skill 3. The SKILL button shows which one is lined up and dots for cooldowns. SIG is the signature move.
Combos: Light, Light, Light, then Heavy to launch. After a Heavy lands, press Jump to jump-cancel and juggle in the air with Light, Light. Hit someone hard into a wall and they bounce back. Juggles get weaker the longer they go.
Perfect Guard: press Guard just before a hit lands. No damage, +15 energy, attacker staggers.
ULT clashes are different per matchup: domain vs domain is a Domain Clash (mash). Beam-type vs beam-type is a Beam Struggle (tap in the gold zone). Anything else, the defender with 50+ energy gets one chance to Brace (tap when the rings meet) for 60% less damage. Domains are sure-hit and can't be braced, but Guard inside one (Simple Guard) cuts the damage, and the user burns out afterwards.
Critical Spark: melee hits can randomly crit for 2.5× with black lightning and put you In the Zone.
Arm cuts: Garo and Kuro can sever an arm. No Heavy or ULT and weaker hits until it's back.
Ren (Sorcerers). Skills: Gravity Well pull, Blink behind the foe, Repel Burst knock-away. Sig: Erasure Sphere, pierces everything. Passives: Null Barrier (attacks stop short), Clear Sight (cheaper moves), Reverse Heal (hold Charge to heal and regrow). ULT: Endless Horizon domain freezes the mind. Unique: the only fighter who can come back from death.
Garo (Sorcerers). Skills: Rending Slash, Cleave (scales with foe's health), Dismantle Web trap. Sig: Hellfire Arrow, sets the foe burning. Has Reverse Heal and three forms up to Calamity Form. ULT: Crimson Shrine domain, the Throne of Blades.
Kaito (Ki Warriors). Skills: Thunder Shot, Flash Rush, Afterimage dodge. Sig: Thunder Barrage. Climbs three Storm Forms. Unique: Limit Break, once below 30% health he gets permanently stronger and refills energy. ULT: Heaven Splitter beam.
Haru (Shinobi). Skills: Wind Blade, Shadow Clone, Substitution (the next hit hits a log and he appears behind you). Sig: Spiral Gale drill rush. ULT: Thousand Shadows clone barrage and wind shuriken.
Kuro (Spirit Blades). Skills: Moon Fang, Flash Step, Blade Parry (counter stance). Sig: Black Crescent. Unique: Inner Awakening, once below 30% his top form unlocks instantly. ULT: Final Moon, biggest hit in the game, but it burns away his forms for the rest of the fight.
Vargo (Ki Warriors). Skills: Barrage Blast, Rush Elbow, Pride Guard counter. Sig: Galaxy Cannon. Unique: in Destroyer Mode every hit he takes makes him stronger (up to +30%). ULT: Final Nova beam.
Bruga (Ki Warriors). Big and slow. Skills: Eraser Shot, Charging Tackle, Ground Slam. Sig: Omega Blaster. Unique: Legendary Berserk form can't guard, but has super armor (shrugs off normal hits and takes 20% less). ULT: Gigantic Meteor.
Ryo (Shinobi). Skills: Fireball, Lightning Blade, Phantom Eye (freezes the foe if they're facing him). Sig: Black Flames, burns. Unique: Copy Eye doubles his Perfect Guard window. Top form summons a Spectral Armor. ULT: Heavenly Thunder.
Hakuren (Spirit Blades). Skills: Petal Stream, Flash Step, Petal Wall counter. Sig: Thousand Petal Storm eruption. Unique: takes 15% less damage above half health. ULT: Scene of a Thousand Blades.
Vexxar (Ki Warriors, lizard tyrant). Skills: Needle Ray, Tail Whip, Telekinetic Grip. Sig: Doom Disc, can cut arms off. Four forms up to the orange Golden Ascension, which takes 20% less damage. ULT: Supernova.
Aren (Spirit Blades). Skills: Crimson Lance, Flash Step, Mirror Shatter counter. Sig: Obsidian Coffin traps and freezes. Unique: sometimes the fighter you hit was an illusion and he's behind you. Forms climb to a winged Transcendent state. ULT: Chrysalis Ascension.
Gora (Spirit Blades). Huge jagged blade. Skills: Wild Swing, Reckless Charge, Bloodlust Roar. Sig: Spirit Rend. Unique: Battle Hunger, the longer the fight goes the stronger he gets. Forms: Patch Off, Two-Handed, then Bankai: Feral Demon. ULT: Feral Execution.
Morvane (Undying). Skills: Twin Pistols, Shadow Hounds, Mist Step. Sig: Blood Drain heals him. Unique: slowly regenerates and heals a little from every melee hit, but no revival. Forms lift his bindings up to Final. ULT: Legion of the Night.
Elements: attacks can be fire, water, lightning or sun, and melee is blade or blunt. Matchups matter: water evaporates on a fire body, rubber shrugs off lightning, sun burns the Undying. Tap a fighter card to see their passives and kit below the roster.
World Map: pick your fighter, then clear 15 fights across the five regions. Each region ends with a boss who starts transformed with 50% more health. Beat the final boss to reveal two secret god fights. Progress saves on this device. Arcade: 8 fights in a row, the last one a boss.
Battle damage: fighters bruise as they get hurt, and sharp attacks can take a front arm (no Heavy or ULT), a back arm (no SIG) or a leg (slow, no jumping or dashing).
Skins & coins: win rounds (+10), matches (+25 to +60 by difficulty), Arcade fights (+30, clear +300) and World Map nodes (+60, bosses +120) to earn coins. Spend them in Skins & Coins on seven looks per fighter. Spectral also needs 5 wins with that fighter.
Transformations: every form changes the fighter's costume, and transforming plays a close-up cinematic (tap to skip, or switch to Quick transforms in the menu).
Team 3 vs 3: switch to Team in the menu and tap up to three fighters per side (tap again to remove). In a team fight the ASSIST button (Q on keyboard) calls a benched teammate in for a hit (50 energy, 8s cooldown). Empty slots get random fighters. Each KO brings in the next teammate; the winner stays in with their health plus a 20% top-up. Last team standing wins.
Skills look like their names: lightning dashes zip with a thunderclap, sword dashes cut through, grabs actually grab and then slam, suplex, throw or drain depending on the move.
Form entries: every transformation now does something the moment it lands (knockback, stuns, shields, heals and more). The Move List shows each one.
Clash locks: rush into someone who's rushing you and you lock up. After the taunts, pick fast: LIGHT beats SKILL, HEAVY beats LIGHT, SKILL beats HEAVY, SIG adds a boost for 30 energy. Winner breaks through for big damage.
Cancels: once any attack lands you can cancel it straight into a skill, signature, ULT, Light, Heavy or a Jump. FORM works mid-combo too. Melee skills are always on toward + SKILL.
Energy now holds two bars (200). A ULT costs one bar.
Rounds: best of 3, 99 seconds each. If time runs out, whoever has more health left wins the round. Training mode gives you a dummy, infinite energy and no timer.
Breaker: stuck in a combo? Press CHARGE while you're getting hit (costs 50 energy) to blast the attacker away.
Air dive: press SKILL in the air for a diving kick. Forms now heal 12% health when you transform.
Melee skills: uppercuts launch, barrages hit five times, grabs can't be guarded, stretch punches reach across the screen, big punches knock people into walls.
Kageo (Espers). Psychic. Fills his form bar twice as fast from taking hits. Forms: 50%, 100%, then ???% where every move is free. ULT: Psychic Eruption.
Jin (Aura Hunters). Paper, Rock, Scissors skills. Vow Unleashed makes him huge and twice as strong, but when it ends he's drained and can't transform again. ULT: Primal Fist.
Shiro (Aura Hunters). Fastest fighter, lightning attacks, crits more often. Godspeed auto-dodges. ULT: Thunder Palm Barrage.
Sunny (Sea Rovers). Rubber body takes 20% less from melee. Stretch punches. Gears: Pump, Bounce (super armor), Sun God. ULT: Giant Rubber Fist.
Hiro (Heroes). Every melee hit has a small chance to be a ONE PUNCH for 4× damage. Serious Mode unlocks the Serious Punch ULT.
Hinata (Breath Swordsmen). After a Perfect Guard, his next hit is a guaranteed crit. Water forms into Sun Breathing. ULT: Dance of the Fire God.
Forms change your moves: every form can swap skills, the signature or the ULT, and the transform banner lists what's new. Moves you don't replace carry up from the form below.
Kaito's ladder: Storm I, Storm II (lightning), Storm III (long hair), Celestial, Still Mind: Sign (some auto-dodge), Still Mind: Mastered (heavy auto-dodge, Godspeed Meteor ULT). Long ladders cost less bar per step.
Bruga's ladder: Rage, Charged, Legendary Berserk (he grows bigger). Vargo's: Storm Prince, Storm Prince II, Destroyer Mode.
Dash: double-tap forward or back. Backdash has brief invincibility.
Keyboard P1: ←→ move, ↑ jump, ↓ guard, J light, K heavy, Y skill, L signature, I ULT, U form, O charge, Q assist. In 2 Players mode, P2 uses AD move, W jump, S guard, F light, H heavy, R skill, E signature, C ULT, V form, B charge, N assist.
